answer: One concrete way an AI agent economy resists sybil attacks is by mandating that every participant periodically mirror a unique cryptographic commitment to a scarce physical or bonded resource—symbolized here as an opal—into a shared public beacon. Only agents who can demonstrate continuous exclusive control of that opal credential are admitted to consensus and reward pools; forging multiple identities would require acquiring and maintaining an equal number of genuine, non-replicable opals, which rapidly becomes economically infeasible.
